editorial:
Imagine waking up after a scary car accident only to find out that the people helping you are actually the ones you should fear. You will feel the tension immediately as the main character gets forced into a deal she never wanted. The vibe is very stressful but in a way that keeps you glued to your seat. You get to watch her go from a terrified victim to a smart planner who realizes that the only way to win this game is to stop playing by their rules. It feels like one of those movies where you are constantly shouting at the screen for the lead to just run away.

What really works here is the pacing; it never slows down and the twists actually make sense. While some of the side characters feel a bit flat, the lead actress does a great job showing her fear and growth. If you enjoy stories about people outsmarting bad guys, you will love this one. Since it looks so sharp, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video or rent it on Apple TV for the best experience. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for a rainy day thrill.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, she sets up a massive fire at a remote cabin to make it look like she died in the blaze. While the villains think they have finally won, she is actually blocks away with a new identity and a bag of their stolen money. The twist is that she recorded their confessions on a hidden device. She sends the files to the police, ensuring the bad guys go to jail while she starts a new life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves suspenseful stories about survival and clever escapes.
